t: A week-long middle school workshop on building movement projects with Scratch and pose tracking.
steps: Find the Dancing with AI curriculum overview from MIT and read it first.
Check that each computer has a working webcam and a current browser.
Open the Scratch extension site and test the hand, body, and face tracking.
Open the Teachable Machine blocks and test a custom pose model.
Ask IT how the school handles webcam access in the browser.
Plan five days of work and follow the lesson order in the curriculum materials.
Check how Teachable Machine handles images before students train models.
